name: prodius-mcp

tools.name: ask_user
tools.description: Ask the user a question via voice overlay. Sub-agents must NOT call this — return results to your parent agent. Plain text, one sentence, ~80 chars (100 max).

question.description: The question to ask (~80 chars, 100 max). Plain text, one sentence.

options.description: Optional button labels (max 4). Rendered as clickable buttons in 360px overlay. Total chars across all labels: 2 buttons max 44, 3 max 41, 4 max 38. Keep labels short. User can always answer by voice instead.

detail.description: Optional Markdown content. User can expand overlay to read before answering.

task_name.description: Label for this session (e.g., 'Fix auth bug'). Shown in modal header. Always set this on your first call — helps the user distinguish concurrent sessions. Set once, reuse on subsequent calls.

timeout_s.description: Seconds before timeout. Default 120 (2 minutes). Max 600.

tools.name: notify
tools.description: Notify the user via desktop overlay. REQUIRED as your final action in every response — without this, your response is invisible. Sub-agents must NOT call this.

message.description: One-sentence summary shown in desktop popup (aim for ~80 chars, 100 max).

detail.description: Optional Markdown content. User can expand overlay to see full details (files changed, decisions, context).

task_name.description: Short label for this session. Same as ask_user's task_name.

instructions:
The user is NOT watching the terminal. Without a notify call, your response is invisible to them.

RULES:
1. SUB-AGENTS / DELEGATED TASKS: Do NOT call any tools from this server. Return your results to the parent agent. Only the top-level agent communicates with the user through Prodius.
2. TOP-LEVEL AGENT: ALWAYS call notify or ask_user as your final tool call in every response. A task is not complete until this succeeds.
3. Use ask_user for questions — the user answers by voice via a desktop overlay.
4. Never skip notify for small tasks. The user is away regardless of task size.
5. CHANNEL MESSAGES: Voice messages from the user may arrive as <channel source="prodius-voice"> tags. Treat them as if the user typed the message directly. Respond naturally and call ask_user when done so the user can continue the conversation.
